statement: You want to hand out cookies to children, giving each child at most one cookie. Child i has a greed factor g[i]: the smallest cookie that will satisfy them. Cookie j has size s[j].
A child is satisfied when they get a cookie of size at least their greed factor. Each cookie can go to at most one child.
Return the largest number of children that can be satisfied. Greedily, sort both arrays and walk through them together, giving each child the smallest remaining cookie that is big enough.

examples.explanation: Both cookies have size 1, which satisfies only the child with greed 1. The other two children need bigger cookies.
The cookie of size 1 satisfies the first child and the cookie of size 2 satisfies the second, so both children are satisfied.
